name: Clovis Steel LLC
about:
Clovis Steel LLC was founded in 1999 in Clovis, New Mexico, initially as a steel retailer. The company has since expanded into a full-service building center with a second location in Canyon, Texas. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company supplies structural steel, sheet metal, and a broad range of building materials including plumbing, fencing, concrete, garage doors, and welding supplies. It also designs and fabricates custom metal buildings—offering bolt-up, cold-formed, and weld-up systems—and provides engineering support such as stamped foundation drawings and building take-offs. Operations span two facilities, though square footage and headcount are not published.

Customers include contractors, engineers, agricultural operators, and residential builders across the construction, agriculture, and commercial building sectors. The firm’s building packages have been used for projects ranging from small storage structures to large commercial facilities, and its materials meet ASTM standards for fencing and other applications.

Clovis Steel emphasizes bilingual customer service, free estimates, and material delivery to job sites. It backs its R Lock and M Lock steel panels with a lifetime warranty and stocks pre-engineered Centra Series kits that can ship within two weeks. The company states that its focus on fast turnaround and personalized support distinguishes it in the regional market.
